The patch is a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list with EXACTLY ONE 'symbol' entry, name = 1-part top-level '_report_package_ok', with readiness_score riding as the trailing extra node; no __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__, no dotted qualname, no whole-file rewrite, no 'readiness_score' anchor.

spec.objective: Give ngv2/submission_readiness_gate.py a REAL readiness_score provider so readiness() can return {'ready': True, 'missing': None} for a fully-stocked finding on the live (un-monkeypatched) path, unblocking the bounty-FSM report -> awaiting_submission edge. The defect: the module-level import chain tries `from ngv2_submission_package_builder import readiness_score` then `from ngv2.submission_package_builder import readiness_score` — BOTH PHANTOM — so _readiness_score falls back to None, _report_package_ok returns False unconditionally, and every fully-stocked finding parks at {'ready': False, 'missing': 'report_package'}. The fix is a call-time fallback inside _report_package_ok plus a new inlined module-level readiness_score(package). DO NOT touch the module-level try/except import block.
functional_requirements: REWRITE the existing top-level function _report_package_ok to select its scorer AT CALL TIME — `scorer = _readiness_score if callable(_readiness_score) else readiness_score` — then keep the existing try/except + `score == _REQUIRED_READINESS_SCORE` logic, reproduced VERBATIM per the Scope target so the committed gate oracle's gate._readiness_score monkeypatch seam keeps being honored via the callable() check.

ADD one NEW top-level function readiness_score(package) implementing legacy 0-3 semantics: return 0 for non-dict input; else award one point per artifact GROUP present and truthy — group 1 ('submission_pkg','report','report_markdown','package_markdown','markdown','title'), group 2 ('poc','poc_file','poc_reference'), group 3 ('live_test','live_test_evidence','live_report'); pure/deterministic, never raises, stdlib only.

Leave the module-level try/except import block, the module docstring, all module constants (MISSING_*, PRECEDENCE, ELIGIBLE_CONFIDENCE, _CONFIRMED_VERDICT, _REQUIRED_NOVELTY, _GO_DECISION, _REQUIRED_READINESS_SCORE), and every other top-level symbol (_attr_or_item, _confidence_ok, _live_test_ok, _novelty_ok, _bounty_ok, readiness) BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged.

Emit the change as a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list with EXACTLY ONE 'symbol' entry whose name is the 1-part top-level '_report_package_ok' (the anchor), with the new readiness_score function riding as the TRAILING extra node — the R-anchor pattern for introducing a new top-level symbol; never a 'readiness_score' anchor (KeyError), never a dotted qualname, never a __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__, never a whole-file rewrite.
spec.interfaces: edits ngv2/submission_readiness_gate.py: (1) _report_package_ok(package: Any) -> bool selects `scorer = _readiness_score if callable(_readiness_score) else readiness_score`, then `try: score = scorer(package) except Exception: return False` and `return score == _REQUIRED_READINESS_SCORE`; (2) new top-level readiness_score(package: Any) -> int returns 0 for non-dict, else sums one point per truthy artifact group over groups (('submission_pkg','report','report_markdown','package_markdown','markdown','title'), ('poc','poc_file','poc_reference'), ('live_test','live_test_evidence','live_report')). Both pure/deterministic, no clock/randomness/network/subprocess, stdlib only. The module-level `_readiness_score = None` import-or-None semantics and the gate oracle's gate._readiness_score monkeypatch seam are preserved.
edge_cases: test_ready_true_is_reachable_without_monkeypatch: a fully-stocked package dict (carrying every key group named in Scope) drives readiness() UNPATCHED to {'ready': True, 'missing': None} on the live path.
test_partial_package_still_parks_on_report_package: a package stripped of all live-test keys scores < 3 and still parks at {'ready': False, 'missing': 'report_package'}.
test_confidence_precedence_unbroken: the readiness() precedence order is undisturbed — a sub-eligible confidence still parks on its own missing reason ahead of report_package.
test_gate_has_a_real_readiness_score_provider: the gate exposes a callable readiness_score provider on the live un-monkeypatched path (no PHANTOM-IMPORT fall-through to None blocking ready==True).
non_goals: Integration/e2e testing is OUT OF SCOPE — do NOT add integration or e2e tests; this fix is verified solely by the committed unit oracles tests/ngv2/test_submission_readiness_ready_path_wired.py and ngv2/tests/test_submission_readiness_gate.py.
Do NOT author or modify any test — both oracles are committed and authoritative.

Do NOT create the module ngv2/submission_package_builder.py (or top-level ngv2_submission_package_builder.py) — the phantom import stays phantom; the fix is the call-time fallback inside _report_package_ok.
Do NOT modify ngv2/submission_package.py, ngv2/submission_readiness.py, ngv2/session_gate.py, ngv2/session_api.py, ngv2/contracts.py, or any module other than ngv2/submission_readiness_gate.py.

Do NOT change the module-level try/except import block, the module docstring, any module constant (_REQUIRED_READINESS_SCORE stays 3), the readiness() function, its precedence order, or any helper other than _report_package_ok.
Do NOT make readiness_score honor a '_mock_score' key (that is an oracle-side monkeypatch convention, not production behavior).

PATCH-SHAPE: do NOT anchor on the not-yet-existing 'readiness_score' (KeyError), do NOT emit a dotted qualname, a __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__, or a whole-file rewrite; the new function rides ONLY as the trailing extra node of the '_report_package_ok' symbol patch. No new imports, no network, no wall-clock, no randomness, no third-party dependencies.
